decisions.reason: The application lists metric extents of the inlier face as an output the dynamic handler needs: width is the camera-x span, height is the camera-y span, and depth is the mean range. Stage 2 already stores those extents on the estimate, and PalletPoseStamped on /pps/pallet_pose_rich does not carry them. Publishing width, height, and depth with that same pose lets the handler size the pallet from the estimate it is about to use. This is a product output, not a restatement of scenario_error.

The application output is those extents on the pose the handler uses, not a hold when the face is a fraction of the nominal 1.20 m by 0.14 m prototype. Setting accepted false with quality reason partial_face withholds the pose instead of publishing width, height, and depth. The proposal is a real gate and does not merely restate scenario_error; it is rejected because this cycle admits the published extents.

The handler needs the size from the depth frame paired with the pose, because the scene can still change. Comparing later frames and republishing accepted false with quality reason scene_moved is a later withdrawal, not that paired output. Pose publication and deferred selection already exist. The proposal does not merely restate scenario_error; it is rejected because this cycle admits the inlier-face extents on the same rich pose.
